subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should changed-input Codex refreshes pay the additional full lineage shadow-pass cost at this stack stage, or must shadow execution be further bounded or opt-in before merge?
rationale: The patch is intentionally non-authoritative and functionally contained, but the linked corpus measurements show that lineage processing is large enough to affect refresh availability; only maintainers can accept that production tradeoff.

options.title: Bound shadow execution first
options.body: Require sampling, explicit opt-in, or a time/work budget before merging so normal changed-input refreshes cannot nearly double scan work.

options.title: Accept temporary stack latency
options.body: Merge in stack order while explicitly accepting the intermediate changed-refresh cost until the later safety and optimization slices land.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the full four-PR stack can be evaluated as one runtime and upgrade unit with exact-head proof.

recommendation.title: Bound shadow execution first
recommendation.body: Require sampling, explicit opt-in, or a time/work budget before merging so normal changed-input refreshes cannot nearly double scan work.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level performance and rollout tradeoff rather than a mechanical correctness repair.
